---
title: "Policy work"
description: "Policy research on municipal finance, global value chains and urban sustainability, written for governments in low-resource settings."
---

For a decade I wrote for finance ministries, city treasuries and mayoral teams
across Africa, Asia and the Caribbean, mostly through the International Growth
Centre's Cities that Work initiative. That work has 61 externally validated
instances of uptake by decision-makers, across 27 countries and four
international organisations, a measure audited by the IGC's government funder.

The work below was written to be used rather than cited. Several pieces exist
in French, Somali, Arabic or Hindi; ask if you need one.
